BrochureContent.Content:
David Ross Estate Agents, your local property experts, are delighted to present No. 62 Cooley Road to the market.
Situated in this ever-popular and well-established residential location, No. 62 Cooley Road offers purchasers a rare opportunity to acquire a beautifully renovated end of terrace family home that effortlessly combines period character with modern convenience. Extensively upgraded and modernised following its purchase, this impressive property has been thoughtfully transformed into a comfortable, energy-efficient and low maintenance home, ready for immediate occupation.
Behind its attractive façade lies bright and well-proportioned accommodation designed to meet the needs of modern family living. The extensive programme of renovation has been carried out to an exceptional standard, ensuring that every aspect of the home has been carefully considered to maximise comfort, functionality and efficiency.
The property benefits from full internal insulation of all external perimeter walls using 50mm insulated plasterboard throughout both the ground and first floors, significantly enhancing thermal performance and contributing to an impressive improvement in the BER rating from G to C.  In addition a complete electrical rewire was undertaken, complemented by Cat 6 data cabling with internet points installed in all rooms, a new house alarm system and a substantial increase in electrical socket provision throughout the home.
Further enhancements include a new gas-fired combi boiler and central heating system, new radiators throughout and the complete replumbing of the property. Stylish contemporary bathrooms, showers and a convenient downstairs WC have been fitted, while the modern kitchen features elegant concrete worktops, creating a practical and sophisticated heart to the home.
The property’s original flooring has been carefully restored and refinished, preserving its character while seamlessly integrating with the home’s modern upgrades. Outside, the front garden provides valuable off-street parking for two cars.
To the rear, the private garden has been designed with ease of maintenance in mind, featuring a raised deck level with the back door and artificial grass, creating an ideal space for outdoor dining, entertaining and family enjoyment throughout the year. The attic has also been fully floored, providing extensive and easily accessible storage space.
The majority of these improvements were completed during a comprehensive renovation programme shortly after purchase, transforming No. 62 Cooley Road into a turnkey residence where the next owners can simply unpack and enjoy.
Combining bright and well-proportioned accommodation, extensive modern upgrades and a highly convenient location close to a host of local amenities, schools and transport links, No. 62 Cooley Road presents an exceptional opportunity for families, first-time buyers and investors alike to secure a home of genuine quality in a much sought-after setting.
Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate everything this outstanding property has to offer.
Viewing by appointment only.
